prompt: At a mountain campsite by a clear river, a green dome tent is pitched on a flat clearing beneath tall pine trees. A crackling campfire burns beside a cast-iron cooking pot and a tripod grill, while four camping chairs circle the flames. A red backpack leans against a boulder near a hanging lantern and a rolled-up sleeping bag. A wooden signpost points toward the trailhead beside a stainless-steel thermos and a paper map spread on a weathered log. A brass compass and a pair of binoculars lie next to hiking boots on a plaid blanket. A guitar rests against a tree stump, and a metal marshmallow skewer dips into the embers. A water bottle sits on a rock beside a towel hanging on a branch. A curious squirrel scampers near a pinecone, and a wildflower patch blooms at the clearing’s edge. There is no RV, no smartphone, no car, no plastic bag, and no portable cooler.
